hero.title: Say what you need.
hero.description: Need & Know connects the real problems NGOs and communities are stuck on with the research, experience and expertise that could help, explains why each connection makes sense, and brings in a person where it matters most.
hero.caption: Any country, any of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals.

problem.title: The knowledge exists. It just doesn’t reach the people who need it.
problem.intro: Researchers, practitioners and experienced professionals know things that could change how a project is run. NGOs on the ground face problems that someone, somewhere, has already studied or solved. Most of the time, neither finds the other.
cards: Platforms record what organisations are doing: projects launched, pledges made. Almost none record what they’re stuck on. You can’t match a need nobody has written down.
Budgets for outside technical help are the first to be cut, and research takes years to publish. Practitioners need a route to people who know, while it can still make a difference.
Projects end, websites go stale, lessons-learned reports are never made public. The next team starts from zero, often in the next village.
problem.closing: Search engines and registries tell you who exists. They don’t tell you who can help with this, here, now.

idea.title:
Start with the need.
Make the connection.
idea.intro: A registry records who has declared something. Need & Know records who needs something.
idea.body: We’re building around the need: a problem, in the words of the people holding it, with what would help, where it’s happening, and by when it matters. A match needs two sides. We bring them together.
rows: Needs, and the people and research that could help

steps: An NGO, municipality or community group says what it’s stuck on, in its own words. It takes about 30 minutes, and it can happen in a conversation rather than a form.
AI helps turn the description into a clear brief: theme, location, the kind of help needed, and the time frame. The original words are always kept.
We suggest people with relevant experience, research and projects that could help. Each suggestion comes with a plain-language reason and a note on what we don’t know yet.
A person steps in where it matters.
A broker with domain experience helps shape the need into a question an expert can answer, and makes the first introduction to researchers who haven’t joined yet. Nothing is sent automatically.
Both sides agree to talk, directly or through the broker. We follow up to see whether the connection worked, and that result is what we measure.

audiences.label: NGOs & local partners
audiences.headline: Get the evidence behind your next decision, without a literature search.
get: Research, methods and expertise relevant to your problem, explained in plain language.
Visibility for others working in the same place, not just on the same topic.
A named person who helps shape your need and introduces you to researchers who haven’t joined yet.
A route to student capacity for applied projects as the platform develops.
ask: Describe one real problem you’re working on.
Tell us whether a suggested connection was useful.
audiences.note: Pilot sign-up is open at needandknow.com/join. It’s free.

audiences.label: Experts: researchers & practitioners
audiences.headline: Put what you know to use while it still matters.
get: Real problems where your knowledge or experience counts.
Feedback from the field, and a visible record of how your work is used.
Applied partners and field sites for questions that need them.
ask: Give up to 2 or 5 hours per request, your choice. Anything beyond that you agree directly with the organisation; we take no cut.
Researchers: check the record we draft from open publication data. Practitioners: join without one, at needandknow.com/join.

Every successful match puts existing research and expertise to use, instead of funding it twice.

audiences.label: Businesses
audiences.headline: Credible partners for your sustainability challenges.
get: Access to research and NGO partners for real-world problems in your value chain.
ask: Tell us how you would like to help shape a later phase.
audiences.note: We’re starting with NGOs and their partners; people from companies are welcome as experts.

features: Every challenge carries what’s blocking progress, what would help, where it’s happening and by when. The holder’s original words are always kept.
Every suggestion shows why it might help, what it’s based on and what we don’t know yet. You’ll never see an unexplained percentage score.
A person with domain knowledge helps shape each need, and makes the first introduction to researchers who never signed up. Search is automated; judgement where it matters isn’t.
Every record carries where the work happens, which isn’t always where the organisation is registered. Find others working in the same place, not just on the same theme.
Research records are drafted from open publication data and marked Seeded until the researcher confirms them. Claim, correct or remove your record.
Every record shows whether it’s seeded, claimed, verified or out of date. Needs expire, so the platform doesn’t fill up with stale listings.

does: Turns messy descriptions into clear, structured briefs.
Explains each suggestion in plain language.
never: Contact a researcher who never signed up. Only a person does that.

pilot.intro: We start small, with real needs from NGOs and their local partners, and prove the mechanism works before we grow.
facts: Any of them, in any country
What an expert gives per request, their choice
phases: Conversations with NGOs, networks and experts, under way since autumn 2026.
From December 2026, real needs from NGOs and local partners go to volunteer experts.
Ten real needs by 31 January 2027, comparing introductions made by a broker with direct contact.
July 2027: publish what worked and what didn’t, then go live or stop.

sdg.title: Any country. All 17 goals.
sdg.body: Need & Know works across all 17 of the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals, in any country. A need can be about water, health, education, child protection, climate or any other goal.

scc.title:
Independent by design.
Connected by purpose.
scc.intro: The Sustainability Collaboration Center exists to help sustainability knowledge turn into action, faster. Need & Know is the first thing we’re building to do that.
scc.body: SCC is being set up as a nonprofit association in Switzerland. Its independence is central to the idea: no shareholders and no commercial interest in who gets matched.
values: We measure conversations started, not listings.
We say what we don’t know.
Of their data, their records and their introductions.
